exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and make a straight line from head to heels. Brace your abs and glutes, lower your chest under control with elbows about 30–60 degrees from your body, then push the floor away.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid sagging or raised hips, flared elbows, half reps, or reaching your head toward the floor before your chest.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Start with hands about shoulder-width apart and hips high in an inverted-V. Bend your elbows to lower the crown of your head slightly in front of your hands, then press back up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Do not turn it into a normal push-up, let your hips collapse, or crash your head into the floor.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place your hands just inside shoulder-width. Keep your elbows relatively close to your ribs as you lower your chest, then press the floor away.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid an extremely narrow hand position, flared elbows, sagging hips, or shortened range of motion.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Place your feet on a stable chair and your hands on the floor. Brace your body, lower your chest under control, then press back up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Use only a stable chair. Avoid sagging hips, excessive shoulder discomfort, or cutting the range short.

exercises.name: Chair Dip
exercises.instructions: Use a heavy, stable chair that cannot slide. Place your hands on the edge, keep your shoulders down, bend your elbows to lower your body a comfortable distance, then press back up.
exercises.commonMistakes: Do not use an unstable chair, drop too deep, shrug your shoulders, or force a painful range of motion.

exercises.name: Prone Elbow Row
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead. Pull your elbows toward your ribs while squeezing your shoulder blades, then slowly reach forward again.
exercises.commonMistakes: Do not yank the elbows, shrug, lift your chest excessively, or use momentum.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with your hands near your hips. Lift your hands slightly and sweep your arms in a controlled arc overhead, then return slowly.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid shrugging, bending the elbows excessively, lifting your head, or swinging your arms.

exercises.name: Superman Pull-Down
exercises.instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead. Lift your hands slightly, pull your elbows toward your ribs while squeezing your upper back, then reach forward before lowering.
exercises.commonMistakes: Keep your neck neutral and use a controlled range. Do not crank your lower back into a deep arch.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
exercises.instructions: Lie face down and raise your arms into a Y, then T, then W. Pause briefly in each position and squeeze your shoulder blades.
exercises.commonMistakes: Use small controlled movements; avoid shrugging, throwing your arms upward, or arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Stand about shoulder-width apart. Sit your hips back and down while bending your knees, then drive through your whole foot to stand tall.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid knees collapsing inward, heels lifting, excessive forward lean, or cutting the range short.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Place the top of one foot on a stable chair behind you. Lower under control with most of your weight on the front leg, then drive through that foot to stand.
exercises.commonMistakes: Use a stable chair. Avoid bouncing, letting the front knee cave inward, or pushing mostly from the rear leg.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand on one leg with a soft knee. Hinge at the hip while reaching the free leg behind you, keeping both hips facing the floor. Squeeze the glute to return.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid rounding your back, rotating the pelvis, locking the standing knee, or reaching farther than your balance allows.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Keep your planted foot flat and your hips level. Drive through the planted foot to lift your hips, pause while squeezing the glute, then lower slowly.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid rotating the pelvis or driving the movement through your lower back.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand on one foot, rise as high as possible onto the ball of your foot, pause at the top, then lower slowly through a full range.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid bouncing, rolling the ankle outward, bending the knee excessively, or pulling yourself up with your hands.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent. Press your lower back gently down, curl your pelvis toward your ribs until your hips lift slightly, then lower slowly.
exercises.commonMistakes: Avoid kicking your legs, swinging, or turning the movement into a large hip swing.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.instructions: Place your elbows under your shoulders, extend your legs, squeeze your glutes, brace your abs, and breathe slowly while keeping a straight line.
exercises.commonMistakes: End the set when your hips sag or rise. Do not hold your breath or crane your head upward.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions: Support yourself on one forearm with your body in a straight line. Brace your core and squeeze your glutes while keeping your hips elevated.
exercises.commonMistakes: Do not rotate your torso toward the floor or let your hips drop.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent. Slowly extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping your lower back controlled against the floor, then return and switch sides.
exercises.commonMistakes: Do not let your lower back arch away from the floor or rush the movement.
